# First Artifact
> A private club for proven, high-agency builders and founders.
> Obsession beats talent; the proof is the artifact.

First Artifact is an invitation-style membership community for people who already ship.
It is not a funding accelerator and is not affiliated with Founders, Inc. Artifact.

## Pages
- [Home](https://firstartifact.org/): manifesto, admission standard, founding team, intended formats
- [About](https://firstartifact.org/about): who runs the club and how it works
- [Privacy](https://firstartifact.org/privacy): how application data is handled
- [Terms](https://firstartifact.org/terms): membership and site terms

## Join
- Apply with shipped work: https://forms.gle/FGJtVdbWxTLgVsKA9
- Discord: https://discord.gg/3nqumWTuHb

## Standard
Membership is earned through evidence of building — high agency, obsession, and traction —
not interest, aspiration, credentials, or talk alone.
